Arsenal currently sit top of the Premier League, five points clear of Brighton in second
Mikel Arteta says his Arsenal players have been warned against inadvertently leaking team news via Fantasy Premier League.
The intervention comes after Christos Tzolis selected and captained himself in his Fantasy Premier League (FPL) team before Arsenal 's match against Liverpool on 1 November, after he had missed a month through injury.
The Gunners manager picked the winger in Arsenal 's starting XI at Anfield in what was his first appearance since Greece's Nations League draw with the Netherlands on 1 October.
Before Saturday's match at Newcastle , Arteta said he had to speak to his squad, and those close to the club, about their FPL selections.
"With Christos, with the squad and with my kids as well," he said
"They're constantly asking me about this as well, because they want to know. It's a topic.
"This is the kind of thing that is happening in our society right now. It's something new. We haven't dealt with it before and we need to put new things in place.
"Obviously, confidentiality is something critical because it's about trust and about what you are trying to do and that should be kept as a huge secret. We'll take measures to make sure it doesn't happen."
The Spaniard also said his players are restricted from selecting themselves in their FPL line-ups.
In October, a number of FPL teams connected to staff and players at Chelsea removed striker Joao Pedro from their teams, hinting the Brazilian had sustained an injury.

Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada (left) with director of football Jason Wilcox
Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada says some of the criticism aimed at the club's hierarchy has "crossed a line".
In a rare interview to Sky Sports as head coach Mauricio Pochettino prepares for his first game in charge, at Liverpool on Sunday, Berrada said he "understood" the frustration of supporters at United being 18th in the Premier League. He also said some of the criticism was "fair".
"Being in this position comes naturally with the criticism and scrutiny we're going to get," he said. "We accept it. Some of it is fair, some of it does cross the line.
"We do live in this world of social media, where people like to generate negative stories about the club because it drives more engagement, and it drives more general noise and activity around the club. But we park that."
United's director of football Jason Wilcox has been singled out by supporters at recent games. There have also been social media calls for both Wilcox and Berrada to lose their jobs.
In addition, songs are now sung regularly calling for minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe to leave, while opposition to the Glazer family has remained intense since their leveraged buyout in 2005 saddled debt on to the club that now exceeds £1bn.
Andrey Santos has started four Premier League games for Manchester United since his £50m summer move from Chelsea
Wilcox, in particular, has been blamed for what is perceived to have been poor summer recruitment. After the 2-0 defeat by Atletico Madrid in September, defender Lisandro Martinez said he "expected more from the technical director".
Ousted boss Michael Carrick felt he was let down by a transfer strategy that targeted midfield, while not addressing issues at left-back and in attack - which has been compounded by injuries to Luke Shaw and Benjamin Sesko.
Carrick wanted to target Elliot Anderson and Mateus Fernandes, but United backed off when Nottingham Forest and West Ham's demands went higher than they wanted to pay. Anderson eventually joined Manchester City for £116m, with Fernandes moving to Tottenham for £85m.
Instead, United paid a combined £118m for Carlos Baleba and Andrey Santos, who have started seven Premier League games between then, and triggered Youri Tielemans' £35m release clause at Aston Villa. Tielemans scored his first United goal in the 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on 8 November and has one assist.
However, Berrada has defended United's transfer business, saying: "When we look at the summer transfer window of 2026, I know we're receiving a lot of criticism for it, but we're actually happy with the players we bought.
"We think that Carlos Baleba, Youri Tielemans, Andrey Santos, and Karl Darlow - and let's not forget that we've also welcomed back Marcus Rashford, who had a very good season on loan at Barcelona - these are five additions that we think have made the squad fundamentally better.
"We went in knowing what we needed to do. Of course, there have been different dynamics at play and we've said consistently in the last few years we need to stay disciplined. We need to take the right decisions. We need to buy the right players, for the right value at the right time - in terms of what the squad needs.
"When we find the right opportunities, we will spend. But what we don't want to be doing is spending just for the sake of it. So, could we have signed an additional defender to straighten the depth and the quality? Yes, but we have to find the right players at the right value.
"There's no point in us spending £40m, £50m for players we're not convinced are going to add value to the team."
When he spoke to the wider media for the first time, 30 minutes before Berrada's interview was aired, Pochettino said he hoped to have a say in all areas of the playing side, even though his official title is head coach.
"I know that, being a head coach, I am the guy that is going to decide the squad for Sunday," he said. "I'm going to pick the starting 11 and I'm going to make the changes.
"Of course, in the future, I would like to be involved in all the main decisions that will happen on the squad."
Berrada said there had been little option other than to dismiss Carrick given United's plight and the team had "dropped off in many areas".
Pochettino has spoken individually to virtually every player to get an understanding of what the issues are.
He said he was wary of reading too much into data that shows United's players have not been running enough, arguing "if you don't put context on the data, it's very dangerous to talk".
The 54-year-old also said that, despite talking extensively about culture in his first in-house interview on Thursday, it could take 10 years to build one.
"The culture of the club and the identity of the club is very clear," he said. "It's a historic club, one of the best in the world. It's difficult to find another club the size of Manchester United.
"The culture of the club and the identity of the club is very clear. It needs to be in a different place than we are now."
Pochettino did confirm Bruno Fernandes will remain as skipper for the trip to Liverpool.
Fernandes has struggled for form and, with the 32-year-old's contract due to expire in the summer, there has been no breakthrough in negotiations over an extension.
United do have the option to trigger an additional year on the Portugal playmaker's present deal but, given the massive dip from the levels that earned him all last season's major player of the year awards, there are some who wonder whether a clean break might be best.
Pochettino preferred to deflect the wider aspect of Fernandes' future and concentrate on the immediate.
"Bruno is our captain and he's a very important player," he said.
"I think we will have time after to talk about the [other] things that you are asking me."

Antoine Semenyo was playing for Bournemouth when the alleged incident happened during a match against Liverpool in August 2025
A Liverpool fan accused of racially abusing footballer Antoine Semenyo has been found not guilty after the player withdrew his support for the prosecution.
Semenyo was due to give evidence at Liverpool Magistrates' Court in the trial of Mark Mogan, 47, who was accused of shouting racist abuse during the opening match of the Premier League season at Anfield on 15 August last year.
But Simon Jones, prosecuting, said: "Following recent contact made with Mr Semenyo, he has indicated he is no longer supportive of proceedings and the prosecution do not consider it is appropriate to compel him.
"In those circumstances we offer no further evidence in the case."
District Judge Mary Dowrick recorded a verdict of not guilty to the charge of racially aggravated behaviour.
Semenyo, who was a Bournemouth player at the time of the incident but is now signed for Manchester City, had been due to give evidence last month but the trial was adjourned halfway through when Mogan was taken to hospital after suffering a seizure.
Mark Mogan was accused of shouting abuse at Semenyo as he prepared to take a throw in
The court had heard that Mogan, in a wheelchair, shouted at Semenyo as he went to take a throw-in about 30 minutes into the game.
As he was preparing to take the throw-in Mogan allegedly shouted a racist insult.
Opening the case last month, Jones said: "That racial abuse was shouted directly at Antoine Semenyo, who was close to him.
"Mr Semenyo briefly froze, as he couldn't believe what the male had said."
Witnesses also said they saw him throw his chewing gum at the footballer.
Semenyo reported the incident to the match referee and Mogan was removed from the stadium at half-time.
Mogan, who had an intermediary with him in court, told police in an interview that Semenyo had called him a cripple after he shouted at the player to "hurry up".
Mogan, of Templehill Close in Dovecot, Liverpool, declined to comment as he left court.

Tom Brady is in discussions about buying a small stake in Chelsea. The NFL legend sold a minority share in Birmingham City this month after three years, a move sources said was to pave the way for investing at Stamford Bridge.
Brady was a guest of Chelsea when they won the Club World Cup in New Jersey last year and was seen celebrating with the players after their remarkable 3-0 final win over Paris Saint-Germain.
The seven-time Super Bowl winner is understood to have a good relationship with Behdad Eghbali, whose fund, Clearlake Capital, owns 86.5% of Chelsea after Todd Boehly and Mark Walter sold their shares in September.
Brady bought into Birmingham in August 2023, less than a year after his second and final retirement from the NFL, after the club’s takeover by Tom Wagner’s Knighthead Capital.
Brady was appointed chair of the club’s advisory board and had a prominent role in the 2025 Amazon Prime documentary Built in Birmingham: Brady & The Blues, which made headlines when he questioned the “work ethic” of Wayne Rooney , who was the manager.
In announcing Brady’s departure the club said: “Birmingham City Football Club expresses its sincere gratitude to Tom Brady for his involvement with and unwavering support for the club over the last three years.”
Brady owns a minority stake in the NFL team Las Vegas Raiders, which he purchased alongside Wagner.

double quotation mark “It’s not just the strikers that can score. We can score from set-pieces, from defenders, from midfielders. It’s teamwork. Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner believes Liam Delap could score 20 goals a season if he improves his all-round game.
Forest’s £50m summer signing from Chelsea enjoyed his best day since joining the club with a double to sink Manchester City earlier this month and Glasner believes that game showcased how the 23-year-old can become even more of a threat.
“I think the City game was where he has his biggest strengths, when he has his pace and he can use his power. And, of course, he can finish with right and left,” said Glasner. “But we’re also working with him around his movements in the box where he has a lot of potential with his physicality.
“Sometimes we arrive in the right areas for assists and then he’s not in the right places. This is what he needs to improve.
“I always said he will have double figures regarding goals at the end of the season because this is just how he is. He should keep this and then work on the other parts of football, and then he maybe goes closer to 20 than 10.”
Daniel Farke wants to create another “bit of history” against Chelsea and end Leeds’ 27-year winless run at Stamford Bridge.

“We know we have to be at our very best in order to give us a chance to win some points. But this is also why we travel. We want to be competitive.

Overlapping. Underlapping. Inverted. Traditional. The role of full-back has evolved dramatically. Once a defensive-first position that provided some auxiliary attacking support, the role has developed into something far more multifaceted.
Just ask right-back Ben White, who – with Riccardo Calafiori on the left – has been an important figure in Arsenal’s superb start to the campaign. Talking a few years ago, he said: “Playing full-back the way [Mikel Arteta] wants is completely different to any other manager. To play full-back for him, you’ve got to be a centre-midfielder, a centre-back, a winger and a No 10.”
Between them, White and Calafiori have contributed to six goals for Arsenal already in the Premier League this season (White: three assists; Calafiori: one goal, two assists). No other defender has registered more than three goal involvements so far. The Arsenal duo are a great illustration of the impact full-backs can have. But, with the position more demanding than ever before, how does each Premier League team deploy theirs?

Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada has spoken exclusively to Sky Sports about the start to the season; the United CEO discusses replacing Michael Carrick with Mauricio Pochettino, the futures of Bruno Fernandes and JJ Gabriel, transfer activity and the Man City charges

In a turbulent time at Manchester United, chief executive Omar Berrada has sat down exclusively with Sky Sports about United's start to the season, the decision to change head coach and facing fan criticism about the club's leadership.
With United in the relegation zone, the club sacked Michael Carrick during the November international break and replaced him with Mauricio Pochettino, who will take charge of his first game away at arch-rivals Liverpool, live on Sky Sports, this Sunday.
The change in head coach has followed a tumultuous opening few months of the campaign, with Lisandro Martinez also taking aim at the club's technical director Jason Wilcox for not preparing the team well enough in the transfer window, while Fernandes also criticised Carrick and his coaching staff's methods.
In this exclusive sit-down interview with Sky Sports' Patrick Davison, Berrada discusses:
Berrada believes United are going in the right direction, even though the club currently sit in the Premier League relegation zone ."One hundred per cent," he says.
"I know it's difficult to say this when you're sitting 18th in the Premier League table. It's clear - it's not good enough, not acceptable, and that's why we've made the change that we've made, so that we can move forward.
"But we are laying the foundations for sustained growth to put us in a position where we can be competitive consistently.
"The foundations are there. I am convinced that we are heading in the right direction."
Read below to see the best of the United chief executive's interview…
This is the third season in a row in which United have changed their head coach in the middle of the season.
This season strongly resembles the 2024-25 campaign that saw United decide to stick with Erik ten Hag despite the club speaking to other potential candidates - only to replace him with Ruben Amorim a few months into the new season.
As a result, the United leadership team has been questioned - even more so after United defender Martinez publicly criticised technical director Wilcox over the transfer window just gone.
Asked if it has been difficult to see the fan criticism about the hierarchy, Berrada says: "It is. I'm not going to lie. But let's be clear, we're not the protagonists. This is not about the individuals, this is about the club.
"This is about doing everything we can to make our fans happy, and that means improving the results on the pitch, and that means getting a team that is performing to its maximum potential, that the fans can feel proud of.
"Being in this position comes naturally with the criticism and the scrutiny that we're going to get. We accept it, some of it is fair, some of it does cross the line.
"I think we do live in this world of social media, where people like to generate negative stories about the club because it drives more engagement, and it drives more general noise and activity around the club. But we park that."
There are lessons to be learned as well. "If you think about the fact that we've had three permanent managers in less than three seasons, clearly we haven't achieved the stability that we want to - that's for sure," Berrada adds.
"There are different circumstances as to why it didn't work out with Erik, Ruben and now Michael. And we're always learning. We're always trying to improve and understand what has failed."
However, while Berrada recognises the club's leadership hold responsibility for the club's success on and off the pitch, that responsibility also filters down to the players and coaches.
"It is our responsibility to run the club," he says. "And, yes, coaches have a very important role to play. Players, of course, have to perform at the highest level consistently for any coach.
"They're part of a club that when you're wearing the shirt, you have an enormous amount of responsibility. And that responsibility means that you have to be giving your best every day in training, in the matches. And that's the same for executives.
"So I understand the frustration from the fans. It's absolutely normal. My commitment is that we're going to do everything we can to make sure that we put ourselves in a position where we're competing to win titles consistently."
At the centre of United fan disgruntlement is the continued running of the club by the Glazer family, who work alongside INEOS chief Sir Jim Ratcliffe at the very top of the structure. Berrada insists, however, that the dual-running of the club is working.
"It's working very well," he says. "I know there's a lot of noise and people look for narratives in the media and that's fine, that comes with being part of this club.
"But from my perspective what I see is a very dedicated and engaged ownership group - both ownership groups. There's constant dialogue, we speak sometimes on a daily basis. Between them there's a very good alignment. I think they have complementary skill sets, if you want to put it that way.
"All the decisions that have been taken, we've been all on the same page, we're all supporting each other, and the shared ambition is to do what's right for the club."
So how did United come to the decision to remove Carrick? The former United midfielder was talk of the town at the end of last season after qualifying the club for the Champions League - but it all unravelled quickly after that.
Many felt United would remove Carrick after the 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth on October 25, but the club waited until the international break to make their move.
"It was a very difficult decision, to be honest, especially given all the affection everyone at the club has for Michael," says Berrada.
"When he took over the team last season, they did very well under him. They were playing some really good football, winning important matches. We qualified for the Champions League and finished third.
"We felt at the time he'd earned the right to continue leading the team. So when we started the season, it's clearly been a lot more difficult than we expected. The results haven't been good enough. I think we've dropped off in many areas.
"We wanted to give ourselves until the November international break to really take stock of what was happening with the team, what were the areas that needed to be improved. And in the end, we took the decision to make a change of coach.
"Unfortunately, sometimes when you're in the middle of the season, that's the one decision that you can make that can provoke a reaction, that can provoke a change in the dynamic. So that's why we had to take the decision."
The signs about Carrick's replacement, Pochettino , are very positive, according to Berrada.
Not only has the Argentine brought a degree of positivity to the club's training ground, but the United chief executive believes he has the "maturity" to take the Old Trafford reins.
"He has a tremendous amount of passion and energy," Berrada says of Pochettino. "We see it already in the two days he's been with us.
"There's a buzz about the place, and he's brought that with his staff. He has a very clear philosophy, identity of how he wants to see the team play. And I think he's coming just at the right time for him and us to be able to help the team and take us forward.
"He's equally as ambitious as we are, which is: we want to win titles.
"You have to think that when you're playing for Manchester United, when the results aren't going well, the pressure and the scrutiny is enormous. And all that noise around the club and around the players can be difficult to manage.

World Cup winners and European champions Spain have reached three of the four Nations League finals, winning in 2023.
World champions Spain will face France while England will play Norway in the quarterfinals of the UEFA Nations League after the draw took place on Friday.
Spain beat France 2-0 in the semifinals of the World Cup in the United States in July on the way to winning the trophy . They also defeated Les Bleus 5-4 in the semifinals of the last edition of the Nations League last year.
The quarterfinals will be played over two legs in late March with Spain at home first after coming second in Group A3 while France topped Group A1 .
Spain won the Nations League in 2023 while France beat them to win the 2021 final.
England topped Group A3 on goal difference after beating Spain away in their last outing, and their reward is a two-legged last-eight tie with Norway with the first leg on Norwegian soil.
England edged Norway in the World Cup quarterfinals this year before losing to Argentina in the semifinals.
The other quarterfinal ties will pit reigning Nations League champions Portugal against the Netherlands and Belgium against Germany.
The winners of the quarterfinals will advance to the final stages, which will be held in June at a venue yet to be decided.
Spain or France will play the Netherlands or Portugal in the single-leg semis, and England would face Belgium or Germany should they get past Norway.

Başakşehir Fatih Terim Stadı'ndaki karşılaşma saat 16.00'da başlayacak. Mücadeleyi hakem Ali Şansalan yönetecek.
Sarı-kırmızılı ekip, son 4 sezonda şampiyon olduğu Süper Lig'de bu sezon 11 müsabakada 9 galibiyet, birer beraberlik ve yenilgi yaşadı. Geride kalan bölümde 28 puan toplayan Galatasaray haftaya lider girdi.
Geride kalan 11 maçta 2 galibiyet, 1 beraberlik ve 8 mağlubiyeti bulunan Samsunspor ise 7 puanla 17. sırada yer aldı.
Galatasaray'da yarınki maç öncesi önemli eksikler bulunuyor.
Sol dizinden operasyon geçiren Nijeryalı Victor Osimhen ile sağ üst arka adale grubunda zorlanma ve kanama tespit edilen Portekizli Rafael Leao, Samsunspor karşısında forma giyemeyecek.
Ayrıca milli takımlarında sakatlık yaşayan Macar Roland Sallai, Rus Aleksey Batrakov ile Kolombiyalı Davinson Sanchez'in durumu maç günü belli olacak.
Öte yandan sağ omuz eklem kapsülünde hafif gerilme tespit edilen Uğurcan Çakır, sarı-kırmızılı takımla çalışmalara başladı. Milli file bekçisi, teknik direktör Okan Buruk'un şans vermesi halinde Samsunspor karşısında forma giyebilir.
Sarı-kırmızılı ekipte 3 futbolcu sarı kart sınırında bulunuyor.
Sezonun geride kalan bölümünde üçer sarı kartı bulunan Davinson Sanchez ve Roland Sallai, yarın oynamaları ve sarı kart görmeleri halinde cezalı duruma düşecek.
Galatasaray, kendi stadı RAMS Park'ta Samsunspor'u ağırlayamayacak.
RAMS Park'ın zemininde gerçekleştirilen bakım ve iyileştirme çalışmalarından dolayı sarı-kırmızılı ekip, rakibini Başakşehir Fatih Terim Stadı'nda konuk edecek.
Galatasaray, kulüp tarihinin ligdeki iç saha yenilmezlik rekorunu kırmak için sahaya çıkacak.
Ligdeki son 41 iç saha maçında 33 galibiyet ve 8 beraberlik yaşayan sarı-kırmızılı takım, Samsunspor karşısında kaybetmemesi halinde sahasındaki namağlup serisini 42 müsabakaya çıkararak rekor kıracak.
Galatasaray, çıktığı son 6 resmi karşılaşmayı galip tamamladı.
Resmi maçlardaki son yenilgisini UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nin 2. haftasında sahasında İspanya temsilcisi Barcelona karşısında yaşayan sarı-kırmızılı ekip, sonrasında Süper Lig'de 4, Avrupa'da ise 2 maçta puan kaybı yaşamadı.
Galatasaray bu süreçte Süper Lig'de Gençlerbirliği (1-0), Fenerbahçe (2-1), TÜMOSAN Konyaspor (4-0) ve son olarak Amed Sportif Faaliyetler'i (4-3) mağlup etti. Sarı-kırmızılılar, UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde ise Fransa'nın Lille (4-2) ve Almanya'nın Stuttgart (2-0) ekiplerini yenmeyi başardı.
Galatasaray'ın yeni transferi Rus Aleksey Batrakov, son dönemdeki performansıyla dikkati çekti.
Batrakov, 4'ü Süper Lig ve 3'ü Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde olmak üzere çıktığı son 7 resmi maçta 6 gol attı.
Ligin son müsabakasında sahasında TÜMOSAN Konyaspor'u yenerek 8 maç sonra galibiyet alan ve moral kazanan Karadeniz ekibi, Galatasaray maçından puan ya da puanlar almayı hedefliyor.
Samsun ekibi, ligin geride kalan bölümünde 2 galibiyet, 1 beraberlik ve 8 mağlubiyet alarak topladığı 7 puanla 17. sırada bulunuyor.
Kırmızı-beyazlı takımda sakatlığı süren Celil Yüksel, Galatasaray karşısında forma giyemeyecek.

Johnstone Burgh won the Scottish Junior Cup, now the Scottish Communities Cup, two seasons ago
Scottish fifth-tier club Johnstone Burgh will no longer be forced to play two cup ties on the same day after one of the fixtures was postponed.
Johnstone were scheduled to play away to Tayport in the Scottish Communities Cup third round at 14:30 GMT and host Dunipace 65 miles away in the Lowland League Cup first round at 15:00 on Saturday.
However, the tie with Tayport has been called off because of a frozen pitch.
The double engagement came about after neither of Johnstone's opponents, nor any other clubs they were scheduled to play on other weekends, were willing to shift from Saturday afternoon kick-off times.

Vitor Matos was due to celebrate a year in charge at Swansea next Tuesday
Vitor Matos admits he knows why Swansea City fans will be angry following his sudden departure from the club.
The Portuguese head coach quit the Championship side this week for the top job at French Ligue 1 club RC Strasbourg.
His move took Swansea by complete surprise, just a week before marking his first year in charge with the club sixth in the table and having signed a new contract until 2030 in July.
Speaking at his first press conference at Strasbourg, Matos admitted he does "not expect any goodwill" from the Welsh club's supporters.
He said: "One situation I need to address is Swansea. It was a really hard and tough decision to leave the club mainly because it was a place from the first day, that treated me with all respect and care – me and my family.
"So it was a really tough decision to leave and that's why I needed to thank everyone there.
"Saying that, I really don't expect any good will from the Swansea supporters after my decision. I understand they are angry with that, but it's a club that I love that I worked every day to make better, me and my staff."
Listen: Ashley Williams' first press conference back at Swansea
Swansea are expecting a compensation package of about £5m and have appointed former players Ashley Williams, Leon Britton, Joe Allen and Kris O'Leary to take temporary charge for Saturday's league fixture against West Bromwich Albion.
"To the staff and to the players I have no doubt they will succeed in the future," said Matos.
"I have no doubt that the manager will go into the office and make the club move forward and fulfil the dreams of the club."
He added: "I'm really proud to be Racing's next manager. This is a wonderful club that deserves all thee respect of everyone."

The overwhelming support from the world of football for Blackburn Rovers boss Tony Mowbray has come as no surprise to interim head coach Damien Johnson.
Mowbray announced on Wednesday he was stepping back from his role at the Championship club because of health issues with Johnson and Mike Dodds taking charge "for the time being".
The news sparked an outpouring of messages of support from EFL clubs and further afield.
"I've known him for over 10 years, but I think people who have only known him in this club for the four or five months he's been in, they can see that. That's just the impact Tony has on people, it's just a testament to Tony and his nature and how he is and how he treats people."
Mowbray, 62, returned to Ewood Park in June for a second spell as head coach and has taken them to 13th place in the Championship after they finished just five points clear of the relegation zone last season.
The former Middlesbrough and West Brom boss had previously taken time out of the game during his spell as Birmingham City boss in early 2024 following a health scare, and later revealed he had been undergoing treatment for bowel cancer.
Boro head coach Kim Hellberg was one of the first to send his best wishes to one of his predecessors.
"He's a brilliant guy. It was really good to meet him and he was absolutely brilliant every time I've talked to him," Hellberg said.
"He's a brilliant football coach. He's done a lot of good things. He's a brilliant human being and you can see everyone knows that."
Rovers have won five of their past nine league games with Johnson crediting Mowbray's impact at the club for creating a more positive atmosphere.
"When the statement came out there was concern - we care a lot about Tony and it was a little bit of a shock - we want what's best for him at this time," Johnson told BBC Radio Lancashire.
"Tony has built a real bond with the whole group and with everyone at the whole club, so there was naturally concern for him and a bit of emotion for a day or so but we all hold him in the highest regard - we hope he's given the privacy he needs.
"He sent a private message to the players which was read out today [Friday] and they appreciated it. He's sent some private messages to staff but Tony's allowed us just to get on, he'll be allowed the time he needs and we'll just get on with the game."
Blackburn visit Burnley on Sunday (12:00 GMT) hoping to end a 10-game winless run against their Lancashire rivals, who have not won a home game in the league since 18 October last year.
Johnson says the match is their main focus rather than what may happen with the managerial situation down the line.
"We've just been focused fully on the game, we know it's a huge game and we've been working with the team throughout the week. The discussions have been about the game and nothing else," he added.
Meanwhile, Blackburn are set to be without goalkeeper Balazs Toth until the new year after he told Hungarian media , external he suffered a hand injury while playing for his national side against Northern Ireland on Tuesday.
"The situation is not that good, but for now it looks like I will be able to avoid surgery," he said before travelling back to England to have the injury assessed by Blackburn.

Kasım ayının sonlarına gelirken pek çok kentte yazdan kalma günler yaşanıyor. Peki havalar neden sıcak ? Meteoroloji Mühendisi Mikdat Kadıoğlu açıkladı. Prof. Dr. Kadıoğlu, 'Bu sıcaklık burada kendiliğinden oluşmadı, güneyden taşındı' dedi.
Kasım ayının sonlarına yaklaşırken İstanbul , Trakya ve İzmir başta olmak üzere pek çok kentte termometrelerin 20 ila 23 dereceye çıktı. Sıcaklık, mevsim normallerinin üzerinde seyrederken 'Havalar neden sıcak ?' sorusunun yanıtı merak edildi.
Yaşanılan sıcak günlerin ardından sosyal medyada sıkça dile getirilen 'iklim değişikliği' yorumlarına yanıt veren İstanbul Teknik Üniversitesi (İTÜ) İklim Bilimi ve Meteoroloji Mühendisliği Bölümü Öğretim Üyesi Prof. Dr. Mikdat Kadıoğlu, merak edilen soruya yanıt verdi.
Meteoroloji mühendisi Prof. Dr. Mikdat Kadıoğlu merak edilen soruya X hesabından bir paylaşım yaparak yanıt verdi. Durumu haritayla açıklayan Mikdat Kadıoğlu, şunları dedi:
'Harita, Ukrayna üzerinde derinleşen bir orta enlem alçak basınç merkezini (L) gösteriyor. Merkezden güneydoğuya uzanan mor çizgi oklüzyon (kapanmış) cephesi. Üçlü noktadan Karadeniz'e uzanan kırmızı çizgi sıcak cephe. Romanya ve Bulgaristan kıyısından Selanik'e inen mavi çizgi de soğuk cephe. İki cephenin arasında kalan bölgeye meteorolojide 'sıcak sektör' denir. Haritadaki koyu lacivert kuşak tam orası: Ege ve Doğu Akdeniz üzerinden kuzeye doğru güçlü bir hava akımı. Biz de bu akımın içindeyiz. Bu akımın bizdeki adı lodos. Farka bakın: Soğuk cephenin arkasında Romanya'da 10–14 derece, Ukrayna'da 6–9 derece. Önünde ise İstanbul 20–21 derece, Trakya ve İzmir 22–23 derece. Aynı gün, birkaç yüz kilometre içinde 10 dereceyi aşan fark. Bu farkı yaratan iklim değil, hava kütlesinin nereden geldiğidir. Yani bu sıcaklık burada kendiliğinden oluşmadı, güneyden taşındı.
Meteorolojide buna sıcak hava adveksiyonu (taşınımı) denir. Soğuk cephe bölgemize ulaştığında rüzgâr kuzeye döner , sıcaklık birkaç saat içinde düşer, yağış başlar. Bu döngüyü her sonbahar ve kış defalarca yaşarız.'
'Peki iklim değişikliği yok mu? Var. Ama iklim tek bir günün değil, en az 30 yıllık hava olaylarının istatistiğidir. Isınan bir iklimde bu tür ılık lodos günlerinin daha sık ve daha sıcak yaşanması beklenebilir. Bunu söylemek için uzun süreli ölçüm ve bilimsel atıf çalışması gerekir. Bir haritaya bakıp 'işte iklim değişikliği' demek bilim değildir. Her sıcak günü iklim değişikliğine bağlarsanız, ardından gelecek ilk soğuk hava dalgasında 'Hani küresel ısınma?' diyenlere de kapıyı açarsınız. İkisi de aynı hatadır: Havayı iklimle karıştırmak.'

Eryaman Stadı'nda saat 13.30'da başlayacak haftanın açılış karşılaşmasını hakem Halil Umut Meler yönetecek.
Son lig maçında deplasmanda Beşiktaş'a 3-0 mağlup olan Gençlerbirliği, haftaya 11 puanla 14. sırada girdi.
Alman teknik direktör Bernd Storck yönetimindeki kırmızı-siyahlılar, bu sezon iç sahada oynadığı 6 lig maçında 2'şer galibiyet, beraberlik ve mağlubiyet yaşadı.
Gençlerbirliği, ligin ikinci haftasında deplasmanda Göztepe'yi 1-0 mağlup ettiği karşılaşmanın dışında ligdeki tüm puanlarını Eryaman Stadı'nda topladı.
Başkent ekibi, Gaziantep FK'yi konuk ettiği son 3 Süper Lig maçında 2 galibiyet ve 1 beraberlik elde etti.
Geçen sezon iki dönemde Gençlerbirliği'ni çalıştıran teknik direktör Volkan Demirel, yeni takımı Gaziantep FK'nin başındaki ilk maçına başkentte çıkacak.
Ligde geride kalan 11 haftada 2 galibiyet, 2 beraberlik ve 7 mağlubiyet yaşayan Gaziantep FK, topladığı 8 puanla 16. sırada bulunuyor.
Gaziantep FK'nin hafta başında anlaştığı teknik direktör Volkan Demirel, daha önceki cezası nedeniyle Gaziantep temsilcisindeki ilk maçında kulübede olamayacak.
Ligdeki son 6 maçını kaybeden Gaziantep ekibinde sakatlıkları bulunan Kacper Tobiasz ve Fuat Bavuk'un karşılaşmada forma giymesi beklenmiyor.
Gaziantep FK ile Gençlerbirliği, Süper Lig'de 7. kez karşı karşıya gelecek.
İki takım arasında ligde daha önce oynanan 6 karşılaşmanın 3'ünü Gaziantep FK, 2'sini Gençlerbirliği kazanırken, bir mücadele beraberlikle sonuçlandı.
Söz konusu maçlarda Gaziantep temsilcisi 10, başkent ekibi ise 7 gol kaydetti.
Geçen sezon Gaziantep'te oynanan karşılaşmayı ev sahibi 2-1 kazanırken, Ankara'daki mücadeleden aynı skorla Gençlerbirliği galip ayrılmıştı.

Türkiye dışında ilk kez Suudi Arabistan 'da düzenlenen Etnospor Kültür Festivali başladı.
"Dünyanın Gelenekleri Riyad 'da" mottosuyla düzenlenen festival, dünyanın farklı bölgelerine ait geleneksel sporları, oyunları ve kültürel değerleri bir araya getiriyor. Organizasyonun dün gerçekleştirilen açılış törenine Türkiye'nin Riyad Büyükelçisi Emrullah İşler, Dünya Etnospor Birliği Başkanı Necmeddin Bilal Erdoğan , Suudi Kraliyet Divanı Danışmanı ve Suudi Arabistan Genel Eğlence Kurumu Başkanı Turki Al-Sheikh, Dünya Etnospor Birliği Yönetim Kurulu üyeleri ile Dünya Etnospor Birliği üyesi federasyonların başkanları katıldı. Dünya Etnospor Birliği Başkanı Necmeddin Bilal Erdoğan ve Suudi Kraliyet Divanı Danışmanı ve Suudi Arabistan Genel Eğlence Kurumu Başkanı Turki Al-Sheikh programın açılış konuşmalarını yaptı.
"Riyadh Season" kapsamında Yeni Murabba bölgesinde düzenlenen ve 28 Kasım'a kadar sürecek etkinliğin açılış töreninde, katılımcı ülkelerin bayrakları sporcular ve takımlar eşliğinde arenaya geldi.
Dünya Etnospor Birliği tarafından organize edilen festivalin töreninde çeşitli konserlerin yanı sıra Mehteran ekibi sahne alarak müzik performansları sergiledi.
Program kapsamında ayrıca atlı okçuluk, dövüş sanatları ve binicilik akrobasi gösterileri gerçekleştirilirken açılış töreni, gösterilerin ardından sona erdi.
"Riyadh Season", Suudi Arabistan'ın 2030 Vizyonu kapsamında başkent Riyad'ı uluslararası bir turizm ve eğlence merkezine dönüştürmek amacıyla düzenlenen büyük çaplı bir etkinlik organizasyonu olarak öne çıkıyor.
Her yıl çok sayıda yerli ve yabancı ziyaretçiyi ağırlayan organizasyon kapsamında uluslararası spor müsabakaları, konserler, kültür ve sanat etkinlikleri, gastronomi festivalleri ve çeşitli eğlence programları gerçekleştiriliyor.
"Riyadh Season" kapsamında bu yıl düzenlenecek Etnospor Kültür Festivali de dünyanın farklı coğrafyalarından geleneksel sporları, oyunları ve kültürel değerleri Suudi Arabistan'da buluşturacak.
Suudi Arabistan'ın başkenti Riyad'da düzenlenen Etnospor Kültür Festivali'nin açılış programının ardından basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtlayan Necmeddin Bilal Erdoğan, farklı kültürlere saygı duymanın önemine inandıklarını, çünkü kültürün bir renk gibi olduğunu belirtti.
Erdoğan, "Defalarca söylediğim gibi mavinin yeşilden daha güzel ya da daha üstün olduğunu savunamazsınız, çünkü farklı bir kültür sadece farklıdır ve hepsi değerlidir. Bir renk aniden ortadan kalksaydı hepimiz üzülürdük, artık o rengi göremezdik. İşte tam olarak böyle ve buna inanmanın dünyadaki barışa giden ilk adım olduğunu düşünüyorum." ifadelerini kullandı.
Dünyanın her köşesinde bu kadar çok savaş yaşanmasının sebebinin kültürlere saygı duyulmaması olduğunu vurgulayan Erdoğan, "İnsanlar her zaman kendilerini üstün görmeye çalışıyor. Bazı topluluklar, bazı kültürler, diğerlerinden üstün olduklarına, kesinlikle daha üstün olduklarına inanıyor. Bu iyi bir fikir değil, barışçıl bir dünya için iyi bir başlangıç değil. Burada tüm geleneksel sporların sergilendiğini görüyoruz, izlemesi eğlenceli, farklı sporlara katılmak sağlıklı. Birçok toplumda, hatta pek çoğunda neredeyse yarısına yakınının hiçbir sporla uğraşmadığını biliyoruz. Örneğin geleneksel okçuluk, kendinizi geliştirmeniz ve başkalarıyla rekabetçi bir şekilde spor yapmanız için aktif olabileceğiniz yeni bir alan sunuyor. Suudi Arabistan'da atlı sporların çok popüler olduğunu biliyorum. Atlı sporları izlemek de çok keyifli." şeklinde konuştu.
Suudi Arabistan'ın Al Nassr Kulübüne yaptığı ziyaretle ilgili konuşan Erdoğan, dünyaca ünlü Portekizli yıldız futbolcu Cristiano Ronaldo'yla görüşmesinden de bahsetti. Yapılan ziyaretin Al Nassr Kulübünün daveti üzerine gerçekleştirildiğini aktaran Erdoğan, şunları kaydetti:
"Riyad'a gelmişken Al Nassr Kulübü davet etti. Antrenmanlarından önce çocuklarla Ronaldo'yu ziyaret etmiş olduk. Futbolun, hatta sporun dünyada gelmiş geçmiş en güçlü isimlerinden biri. Bir selam vermiş olduk, Türkiye'den selam getirmiş olduk. O da güzel bir enstantane oldu."
Türkiye Güreş Federasyonu Başkanı Taha Akgül , Etnospor Kültür Festivali'nin olimpiyat ruhunu yansıttığını belirterek, organizasyonun uluslararası bir nitelik kazanmasından gurur duyduğunu söyledi. Suudi Arabistan'ın başkenti Riyad'da düzenlenen Etnospor Kültür Festivali'ne katılan Akgül, AA muhabirine açıklamalarda bulundu. Akgül, Etnospor Kültür Festivali'nin her yıl büyüyerek geliştiğini aktararak, geçen yıldan bu yana organizasyonun önemli ölçüde ilerleme kaydettiğini dile getirdi.
Festivalin dünyada yapılan sayılı spor ve kültür organizasyonu olduğunu vurgulayan Akgül, "Olimpiyatlar, dünyanın en çok izlenen organizasyonu ve bütün kültürlerin aynı anda birleştiği, din, dil, ırk ayrımının olmadığı bir organizasyon. Bu festival, özellikle kültürel kaynaşma açısından büyük değer taşıyor. Burada olimpiyat ruhunu ve kültürünü hissettik." ifadelerini kullandı.
Akgül, festivalin farklı kültür, din, dil ve ırklardan insanları bir araya getirerek kendi sporlarını tanıtmalarına imkan sağlamasının önemine dikkati çekti.
Etnospor Kültür Festivali'nin yurt dışında ilk defa Riyad'da düzenlenmesinin iki ülke arasındaki ilişkilere önemli katkıda bulunacağının altını çizen Akgül, "Ben iki devletin de bir araya gelmesi anlamında, birbirlerine destek vermesi anlamındaki Pakistan, Suudi Arabistan, biliyorsunuz Türkiye bir ittifak da imzaladı. Bu anlamda spor da bir elçi konumunda; biz de burada birer elçiyiz. Aslında spor diplomasisinin gücünü biz böyle etkinliklerde görüyoruz. Ben bu anlamda çok değerli olduğunu düşünüyorum." şeklinde konuştu.
GÜREŞ FEDERASYONU, FESTİVALE ANTRENÖR VE SPORCULARIYLA DESTEK VERDİ
Taha Akgül, Etnospor Kültür Festivali'ne antrenör ve sporcularıyla katıldıklarını dile getirdi.
Güreş Federasyonu olarak ilk kez geçen sene Etnospor etkinliğinde yer aldıklarını belirten Akgül, "Bu sene de ilk kez uluslararası arenada bu etkinlik yapılıyor ve şu anda Riyad'dayız. Güreş Federasyonu olarak buraya hem minder kurulumu yaptık hem de 10 tane sporcu ve 2 tane antrenörümüzle katılım sağladık; destek vermeye geldik." dedi.
Festival kapsamında güreşin Suudi Arabistan halkına tanıtılmasından mutluluk duyduğunu anlatan Akgül, şöyle devam etti:
"Olimpik güreş, modern olimpiyatların en eski branşlarından, en geleneksel branşlarından bir tanesi ki dünyada uluslararası anlamda da çok geçerliliği olan bir branş. Biz federasyon olarak hem kendi güreşimizi hem de Etnospor'daki kültürü buraya gelen misafirlere tanıtma anlamında Suudi Arabistan'da bir köprü görevi görüyoruz. Çünkü kazandığımız başarılardan dolayı dünya güreşinde sağ olsunlar bir söz sahipliğimiz var. Bunu da kullanmak adına, Etnospor'a katkı sağlama adına biz de buraya destek vermeye geldik."
Taha Akgül, kendilerini organizasyona davet eden Dünya Etnospor Birliği Başkanı Necmeddin Bilal Erdoğan ve Suudi Kraliyet Divanı Danışmanı ve Suudi Arabistan Genel Eğlence Kurumu Başkanı Turki Al-Sheikh'e teşekkür etti.

England have been drawn to face Norway in the UEFA Nations League quarter-finals; the quarter-finals will be two-leg ties and will take place in the March international break; Wales will face Slovenia and Republic of Ireland will take on Croatia in the A/B play-offs
England will take on Erling Haaland and Norway in the Nations League quarter-finals.
Thomas Tuchel's side finished top of their group thanks to their dramatic 3-2 win over Spain at the Metropolitano Stadium, while Norway finished second behind Portugal in Group D.
The two sides met in the 2026 World Cup quarter-finals, with a Jude Bellingham goal in extra-time sending the Three Lions through to the last four.
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Should England progress, they will meet Belgium or Germany in the semi-finals. The other two quarter-final ties have seen world champions Spain drawn with France and Netherlands take on Portugal.
The quarter-finals will be two-leg ties and will take place in the March international break, with the first legs between March 25-27 and the second legs between March 28-30.
This will then be followed by the Nations League Finals, which will be held between June 9 and June 13, 2027.
The tournament will feature two semi-finals, a third-place play-off and the final. The four semi-finalists will be invited to make bids to host the semi-finals and final.
Wales and the Republic of Ireland have also learned who they will face in the Nations League A/B play-offs.
Wales avoided automatic relegation to League B after securing one of the two better last place finishers in League A, while Republic of Ireland finished runners-up in their League B group behind Austria.
Craig Bellamy's side will take on Slovenia, while Heimir Hallgrimsson's men will face Croatia.
The play-off ties will also take place during the March international break.

Ligde iki takımın karşı karşıya geldiği 42 maçta, sarı-lacivertlilerin üstünlüğü bulunuyor. Fenerbahçe rakibini 22 kez mağlup ederken 13 müsabaka beraberlikle sonuçlandı. Körfez ekibi, 7 kez kazanan taraf oldu.
Sarı-lacivertliler, söz konusu maçlarda rakip fileleri 76 kez havalandırırken, Kocaelispor 33 gol sevinci yaşadı.
İki takımın Kocaeli'deki puan mücadelelerinde Fenerbahçe 9 galibiyet aldı. Ev sahibi takım 7 kez kazanırken 5 müsabaka berabere sonuçlandı.
Fenerbahçe, söz konusu maçlarda rakip fileleri 32 kez havalandırdı, kalesinde 24 gol gördü.
İki ekibin geçen sezon Kocaeli'de oynadığı lig maçını Fenerbahçe 2-0 kazanmıştı.
Fenerbahçe ile Kocaelispor arasında oynanan müsabakalar, farklı skorlara da sahne oldu.
İki takım arasında oynanan lig maçlarında sarı-lacivertliler, rakibini tam 6 kez 4 farkla mağlup etmeyi başardı.
Fenerbahçe, 2000-2001'de hem içeride hem de dışarıda 4-0 galip gelirken 1995-1996 ve 1992-1993 sezonlarında da aynı skorla kazanmayı bildi.
Sarı-lacivertliler, 1994-1995 ve 1981-1982 sezonlarında da rakibini 5-1 mağlup etti.
İki takım arasındaki en gollü maç ise 1981-1982 sezonunda Kocaeli'de oynandı. Fenerbahçe bu maçtan 4-3'lük skorla galip ayrıldı.
